# Phase Three — Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos renews the whole while every vessel keeps its place,
Awtsmoos.com will now move from plan into verified Shliach interface.

## Files that will actually be rewritten or created
### Existing Home module
- `geelooy/scripts/home-simple/ShliachSpotlightContent.js`

### HTML route family
- `geelooy/Shliach/index.html`
- `geelooy/Shliach/prompts/index.html`
- `geelooy/Shliach/poems/index.html`
- `geelooy/Shliach/gallery/index.html`

### Shared Shliach CSS

### Tests written only after source implementation

## Source-pass order
1. Create route, style, and script directories without changing source content.
2. Rewrite the Home content module in full; do not rewrite the Home HTML because the existing runtime already injects the spotlight.
3. Write every shared CSS module in full.
4. Write every shared browser module in full.
5. Write all four public HTML pages in full.
6. Re-read every source file before any test file is authored.
7. Write the test contract in full, then run existing and new tests plus syntax and line-count checks.
8. Preview every page in a real browser, inspect desktop/mobile behavior, console errors, images, direct GPT anchors, and prompt launch encoding.
9. Write a new post-pass delta artifact comparing every original plan node to actual work. Resolve any delta with a second full-file pass, reread, and verify again.
10. Write final completion evidence only when REMAINING_WORK is empty and no safe relevant action remains.

## Completion gate
The task closes only when the Home canonical logo is visible or safely falls back, all four `/Shliach/` pages load, every actual-GPT CTA points to the exact requested destination, prompt submission produces that base URL plus the complete encoded prompt, motion respects reduced preference, every touched source file stays at or below 120 lines, existing and new tests pass, and browser inspection finds no blocking console, image, navigation, or layout failure.
